ترتجلي (form VIII)
# تَرْتَجِلِي (tartajilī) /tar.ta.d͡ʒi.liː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَجَلَ (irtajala)
# تُرْتَجَلِي (turtajalī) /tur.ta.d͡ʒa.liː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَجَلَ (irtajala)
